description: Least privilege for the main window (security model T10). It may read, identify, connect (check with the provider, then save) and remove provider keys, see and switch the provider-side tools the core offers, read runs' traces and take the run a click in the corral asked to open, see each agent's policy and save one the core checked, and nothing else. Add single permissions per feature, never bundles; keep tests/capabilities.rs in step.
